newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 68,200 MT were up 27 percent from the prior week, but 17 percent below the 4-week average.

South Africa (16,600 MT) and the Netherlands (16,200 MT) were the major buyers, with smaller quantities to Mexico (11,900 MT, of which 10,600 MT was rough), the Ivory Coast (8,900 MT, including 8,500 MT switched from unknown destinations), Spain (6,600 MT--all rough), Nicaragua (4,600 MT), and Haiti (3,800 MT). In addition, 1,300 MT of rough rice was reported to Turkey.

Exports of 87,100 MT--a marketing-year high--were two and three-fifths times the prior week and two and one-tenth times the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Jordan (18,800 MT), the Netherlands (17,500 MT), the Congo (13,000 MT), Japan (10,300 MT), and the Ivory Coast (8,900 MT).
